transform_source: User-supplied Ocean full40 CELL transform, 2026-11-04; not the old map-v1 simple fit and not a claim about newer map geometry
implementation:
import math

def transform(position):
    x, y, z = position
    bx, by, bz = y / 100, -x / 100, z / 100
    gx, gy = math.floor(bx / 40), math.floor(by / 40)
    cx, cy = gx * 40, gy * 40
    ox, oy, oz = 512 + cx - 6693.91505, 160 + cy - 4578.046, 220.48575
    ox = min(512 + 14336, max(512 - 14336, ox))
    oy = min(160 + 14336, max(160 - 14336, oy))
    oz = min(8192, max(-8192, oz))
    return [ox + by - cy, oy - (bx - cx), oz + bz]
validation_scope: Literal supplied formula only. No claim of fit to newer map geometry, floor contact, rotation or pivots. No server/API calls.
